notes.body: Improved REs for comment removal and item parsing, so could see more missing hf items.  Addressed a few, but there are probably some still left.

added 1 commit
  • 87d9a9f3 - dissectors: address some more warnings
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/25731/diffs?diff_id=1894693862&start_sha=fb090059dea1a7b3b3c80a0d9e3d9052a17ec28d)

I got rid of the change to packet-thread.c, didn't really understand what it was trying to do, but this item appears to be used without registering it:

![image.png](/uploads/5069975bc768e15bee4dd0758c159feb/image.png){width=864 height=115}
